turns: Hey, back from work. Tired but okay.
Long day? What were you up to?
Just meetings all day. Now I want to cook something simple, any ideas?
Pretty chill. I'm just sitting with a cup of chai, watching the rain.
Not really, my neighbour was playing music till two a.m.
I just got a new phone.
Nothing fancy, just a mid-range one. The battery is great though.
Do you know anything about chess openings?
Yes, I'm obsessed with the Sicilian Defence. Why does Black get so many chances even though White moves first?
I love old Hindi film music.
Kishore Kumar and R.D. Burman. How did Burman come up with those sounds in the seventies? I keep reading about his experiments.
Have you ever read about the Indus Valley sites?
Some of it. What interests you?
Mohenjo-daro's drainage system. How did they plan a city like that without a written language we can read?
I need to make a decision soon.
I have two job offers. One pays more in Bengaluru, the other is in my hometown. I can't weigh them properly.
My parents want me to do an MBA.
I'm not sure. I'm 25 and I have a decent job. I just don't know if it's worth two years and the loan.
There's a lot of talk about layoffs in tech.
A bit. My company just announced restructuring. Should I start looking around or wait and see?
Do you think it's right to tell a friend a hard truth?
My close friend is in a relationship that is clearly bad for her. I'm not sure whether to speak up.
I just moved to a new city for work.
Honestly lonely. I come home, eat alone, and scroll my phone. I miss my family so much it physically hurts.
My grandmother passed away this morning.
I got rejected by my dream company.
It does. I prepared for six months. I feel like I'm not good enough for anything.
I lost my job today. They called me in and just said it was over. I don't know how to tell my family.
I told my boss I was sick and he saw my beach story.
Mera alarm mujhse personally nafrat karta hai yaar.
Haha roz subah paanch baje bajta hai aur main usse snooze karta hoon, jaise wo mera dost nahi dushman ho.
I've been 'starting my diet on Monday' since 2019.
Haha exactly. My gym membership has been working out more than me.
Haha my dad calls every day to ask if I've eaten.
Yeah. Honestly though, he's been unwell and I'm scared. I try to joke about it but it's hard.
I love cooking but I'm bad at it.
Maggi, ha. Actually, I want to learn real cooking because my mom is sick and I need to cook for the family now.
Sometimes I feel like nothing matters.
That sounds heavy. Tell me more.
I don't know. I just think everyone would be fine without me, honestly.
